_README: Share card text. These are the images that travel, so the specification line matters more here than anywhere. No long dashes: they read as machine-written and Sakari has asked for them out of everything that goes out.

_verified.AQA 7132 and OCR H431: both outgoing. AQA: continue for cohorts taking exams in 2027, replaced by 7138 from September 2026. OCR: final assessment summer 2027, replaced by H436. Edexcel 9BS0 is unchanged for September 2026.
_verified.Edexcel 3.5: Assessing competitiveness, containing 3.5.2 Ratio analysis, which calculates gearing and ROCE only. The margins are 2.3.1 and the current ratio 2.3.2, so the old label 'Theme 3.5 finance' was too narrow for a nine-ratio pack.
_verified.BTEC L3 verb ladder: counted across the whole Extended Certificate specification: Pass uses Explain 7, Explore 3, Describe 3 and five others; Merit uses Analyse 11, Assess 6, Compare 2; Distinction uses Evaluate 15, Justify 2, Assess 1.
